footnote_text: On October 5, 2026, the reporting person entered into an agreement (the "Contribution Agreement") providing for a contribution to the charter fund of Tourism and Entertainment Group LLC ("TEG LLC"), a limited liability company organized under the laws of Uzbekistan in which the reporting person owns substantially all of the interests. Pursuant to the Contribution Agreement, the reporting person transferred 1,000,000 shares of the Company's common stock to TEG LLC for an aggregate price of US$138,268 (US$0.138 per share). The reporting person is deemed to beneficially own the shares held by TEG LLC as a result of his control over TEG LLC. The transfer closed on October 5, 2026.
